reasons.detail: R1 — `collectTestFiles` resolves only `path.resolve(root, specDir, 'tests')` and recursively includes only filenames matching `\.(test|spec)\.(js|ts|mjs)$`, so root tests, `spec.md`, and `.raw/test-execution.log` are not collected; updated tests assert these exclusions.

R2 — `buildGapAnalysisPrompt` and `buildTestFixPrompt` place `testDesign` via `.addSystemPrompt('## Test Design', ...)` and do not add it to `userPrompt`; unit tests now explicitly assert this contract.

R3 — Prompt limit constant is `1_000_000`, and new `runTestReviewWithDependencies` enforces `assertTestReviewPromptWithinLimit` before calling the agent; test-review now routes through this helper, preventing oversized prompt calls.

R5 — Changes are limited to prompt size enforcement refactor and test additions/exports; no code paths for AI scoring, finding classification, auto-fix behavior, CLI option handling, or exit-code branching were modified.

R4 — R1–R3 are covered by added shared tests under tests/unit/flow/commands/review.test.js, while spec-local coverage also exists separately in specs/.../tests and is not required to be discovered by the standard npm test run.
